type.name: StdCodecProfile
type.doc: Standard codec profiles. Used to specify the profile of a video codec implementation.

value.name: H264Baseline
value.doc: H.264 Baseline profile. Suitable for low-complexity applications such as video conferencing and mobile streaming.

value.name: H264Main
value.doc: H.264 Main profile. Offers better compression efficiency than Baseline, suitable for standard-definition video streaming and broadcast.

value.name: H264High
value.doc: H.264 High profile. Provides the best compression efficiency among H.264 profiles, suitable for high-definition video streaming and Blu-ray discs.

value.name: H264HighPredictive
value.doc: H.264 High Predictive profile. An extension of the High profile that adds support for additional features, such as improved error resilience and better performance.

value.name: H265Main
value.doc: H.265 Main profile. Suitable for standard-definition video streaming and broadcast.

value.name: H265Main10
value.doc: H.265 Main 10 profile. Adds support for 10-bit video, providing better color depth and improved compression efficiency compared to the Main profile.

value.name: H265Main12
value.doc: H.265 Main 12 profile. Adds support for 12-bit video, offering even greater color depth and improved compression efficiency compared to the Main 10 profile.

value.name: H265Main16
value.doc: H.265 Main 16 profile. Adds support for 16-bit video, providing the highest color depth and best compression efficiency among the Main profiles, suitable for professional video production and post-production workflows.

value.name: H265FormatRangeExt
value.doc: H.265 Format Range Extensions profile. Adds support for additional features such as higher bit depths, wider color gamut, and improved compression efficiency, suitable for high-quality video streaming and broadcast.

value.name: AV1Main
value.doc: AV1 Main profile. Suitable for a wide range of applications, including web streaming and video conferencing.

value.name: AV1High
value.doc: AV1 High profile. Adds support for additional features such as higher bit depths and improved compression efficiency, suitable for high-quality video streaming and broadcast.

value.name: AV1Professional
value.doc: AV1 Professional profile. Designed for professional video production and post-production workflows, offering support for high bit depths, wide color gamut, and advanced features.

value.name: VP9Profile0
value.doc: VP9 Profile 0. Supports 8-bit video with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling, suitable for web streaming and general-purpose video applications.

value.name: VP9Profile1
value.doc: VP9 Profile 1. Adds support for 8-bit video with 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 chroma subsampling, suitable for professional video production and post-production workflows that require higher color fidelity.

value.name: VP9Profile2
value.doc: VP9 Profile 2. Adds support for 10-bit and 12-bit video with 4:2:0 chroma subsampling.

value.name: VP9Profile3
value.doc: VP9 Profile 3. Adds support for 10-bit and 12-bit video with 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 chroma subsampling.

type.name: VideoCodecFlags
type.doc: Video codec flags. Used to request and check supported codecs.

value.name: None
value.doc: No video is requested. The extension will not initialize.

value.name: H264
value.doc: H.264 video codec.

value.name: H265
value.doc: H.265 video codec.

value.name: AV1
value.doc: AV1 video codec.

value.name: VP9
value.doc: VP9 video codec.

type.name: ComponentBitDepth
type.doc: Bit depth flags for video components. Used to specify supported bit depths for video decoding.

value.name: None
value.doc: No bit depth is specified.

value.name: Bit8
value.doc: 8-bit video component.

value.name: Bit10
value.doc: 10-bit video component.

value.name: Bit12
value.doc: 12-bit video component.

value.name: Bit16
value.doc: 16-bit video component.

type.name: ChromaSubsampling
type.doc: Chroma subsampling flags for video components. Used to specify supported chroma subsampling formats for video decoding.

value.name: None
value.doc: No chroma subsampling is specified.

value.name: C420
value.doc: 4:2:0 chroma subsampling format.

value.name: C422
value.doc: 4:2:2 chroma subsampling format.

value.name: C444
value.doc: 4:4:4 chroma subsampling format.

type.name: VideoCodecDesc
type.doc: Information about a supported video codec.

member.name: codec_profile
member.doc: The video codec to query capabilities for.

member.name: image_format
member.doc: The data format of the video frames for this codec. This field is used to specify the expected format of the video frames that will be decoded using this codec, and can influence the supported bit depths and chroma subsampling formats.

member.name: width
member.doc: Max width of the video frame in pixels.

member.name: height
member.doc: Max height of the video frame in pixels.

type.name: VideoDecoderDesc
type.doc: Information about a video decode operation.

member.name: width
member.doc: Width of the video frame in pixels.

member.name: height
member.doc: Height of the video frame in pixels.

member.name: image_format
member.doc: The data format of the output video frames. This field specifies the expected format of the decoded video frames that will be produced by the video decoder, and can influence the supported bit depths and chroma subsampling formats.

member.name: codec_profile
member.doc: The video codec profile that the decoder will use for decoding. This field specifies the profile of the video codec that the decoder will use for decoding video frames, and can influence the supported bit depths and chroma subsampling formats.

member.name: decode_picture_buffer_count
member.doc: The number of decode buffers that the decoder will use for decoding video frames.

type.name: VideoDecodeInputDesc
type.doc: Variant type for video decode input descriptions. Used to specify the type of input data for a video decode operation.

member.name: bitstream_buffer
member.doc: Input description for a video decode operation that uses a bitstream buffer as input. The buffer view should contain the compressed video data to be decoded.

member.name: offset
member.doc: Offset in the buffer where the bistream data is located.

member.name: size
member.doc: Size of the bitstream data in bytes.

handle.name: VideoDecoderParameters
handle.doc: Handle for video decoder parameters. Represents the parameters and capabilities of a video decoder, such as supported codecs, bit depths, and chroma subsampling formats.

handle.name: VideoDecoder
handle.doc: Handle for a video decoder. Represents a video decoder instance that can be used to decode video frames.

handle.name: VideoDecodeCommandList
handle.doc: Handle for a video command list. Represents a command list that can be used to record video decode commands.

handle.name: VideoDecodingExtension
handle.doc: Handle for the video decoding extension. Used to manage video decoding resources and operations.

init.doc: Initializes {VideoDecodingExtension::} with a request of codecs.

arg.name: request_codecs
arg.doc: Bitmask of requested video codecs. The extension will attempt to initialize with support for these codecs.

func.name: QueryCodecCaps
func.doc: Checks if video decode is supported on the current device.

ret.doc: Result of the query operation. Returns 'Success' if video decode is supported for the specified codec, or an appropriate error code if not.

arg.name: codec_desc
arg.doc: Information about the video codec to query capabilities for. The 'codec' field should specify the codec to check, and the function will fill in the supported bit depths and chroma subsampling formats for that codec.

ret.name: video_decoder
ret.doc: Output parameter that holds the created video decoder handle if the operation is successful.

arg.name: decoder_desc
arg.doc: Information about the video decoder to create.

func.name: CreateCommandList
func.doc: Creates a video command list instance.

ret.name: command_list
ret.doc: Output parameter that holds the created video command list handle if the operation is successful.

arg.name: command_allocator
arg.doc: The command allocator that the command list will use for memory management of command buffers. It @wis_must be created with the same {Device::} as the extension and have {CommandQueueType::VideoDecode} or {CommandQueueType::VideoEncode} specified.

func.name: Begin
func.doc: Opens the command list, so commands can be recorded to it.

func.name: End
func.doc: Closes the command list, so it can be executed on the command queue.

func.name: DecodeFrame
func.doc: Records a video decode command to the command list.

arg.name: decoder
arg.doc: The video decoder that will be used for decoding the video frame.

arg.name: input_desc
arg.doc: Description of the input data for the video decode operation. This field specifies the type and location of the input data that will be used for decoding the video frame.
